decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks have their own page, are cheap to keep in a thermoforming material range, and their demand is still uncertain, so the option stays open.
A PETG blank fits the firm's core thermoforming portfolio with minimal carrying cost and is visibly promoted, so keeping it preserves upside.
The UV-curing lacquer is only mentioned and its value is still unresolved after one year, but carrying a consumable costs little, so it is kept.
The intraoral contrast spray has its own page and supports the digital scanning trend, so its uncertain but promising prospects justify keeping the option.
The custom earmold line is only mentioned and its prospects remain uncertain, but one year is too early to judge, and it shares materials with the core business, so it is kept.
Custom hearing protection earmolds complement the earmold line at low incremental cost, and the evidence is insufficient to abandon them yet.
